name: monospaced-css
description: A super simple, monospaced, flat, classless-friendly stylesheet for simple pages
author: Andrea Rufo (https://www.andrearufo.it)

scripts.build: sass --no-source-map scss/monospaced.scss dist/monospaced.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/monospaced.scss dist/monospaced.min.css && cp dist/monospaced.min.css docs/
